verdict.rationale: React docs explicitly state React supports streaming HTML on the server while data is still being fetched, progressively filling content before JS loads (react-docs-6), and note that full streaming SSR capabilities are typically realized via frameworks like Next.js (react-docs-4, react-docs-7). This is first-party documentation but lacks independent/hands-on corroboration or technical detail on Suspense/streaming APIs. missing for 10: independent verification of streaming behavior, deeper documentation of Suspense/streaming SSR APIs, community benchmarks confirming perceived load improvements.
